final_message:
The `wrap` function in `src/wrap.py` has been fixed. The issue was that the original code always counted a space character before adding any word to the current line, even when starting fresh (when `cur` was empty). This caused words to be split unnecessarily.

The fix:
- Only count a space (`+1`) when there's already text in the current line
- Always use `width` as the limit (not `width - 1`)

Now `wrap("aaa bbb ccc", 7)` correctly returns `["aaa bbb", "ccc"]` instead of incorrectly splitting it into `["aaa", "bbb", "ccc"]`.
